svg.title: The jury graph of lantern-site
svg.desc: The jury graph of lantern-site: 7 personas (primary 4, secondary 2, bystander 1), scoring 6 dimensions across 2 lenses, and 26 findings: 0 open, 0 fixed, 11 dismissed, 15 row. Edges from a persona to a dimension are coloured by the score from 1 to 5; edges to a finding are coloured by its decision. Each dimension shows a median badge per stratum, never one number across strata.

g.text: Personas by stake, the dimensions they scored, the blockers they raised. Edge colour is the score; badges are medians per stratum, never one number.

g.title: aff738 (row) builder-ana on blocks: Team shows Contact us instead of a price, and a price I cannot see is one I cannot afford.
